Home.metaTitle: PUZZLTHINK — Small games for long thoughts
Home.metaDescription: Play Wallgo and Sudoku instantly. A clean collection of thoughtful online board games.
Home.description1: No complicated sign-up. No long setup.
Home.description2: Will you build walls or fill numbers today?
Home.wallgoDescription: Move your characters, build walls, and claim more territory than anyone else.
Home.sudokuDescription: A timeless number puzzle that starts light and keeps you thinking.
Home.clearRulesDesc: Easy to learn, rich in strategy
Home.growingDesc: More board games are on the way

WallGo.metaDescription: Move characters and build walls to claim the largest territory in this three-player strategy game.
WallGo.placement: Choose an empty tile for your character
WallGo.placeWall: Build a wall beside the character you moved
WallGo.rule1: Move one character one or two tiles in a straight line.
WallGo.rule2: You must build a wall beside the character you moved.
WallGo.rule3: When all players are separated, the largest territory wins.
WallGo.breakDescription: Once per player, break a wall that blocks your movement path.
WallGo.logFirst: Place your first character on any empty tile.
WallGo.logSkipped: {player} had no legal move and passed.
WallGo.logBotTurn: {player} moved {breakText}to {cell} and built a wall on the {direction}.
WallGo.logBreakUsed: Wall break used. Now build a wall.
WallGo.logMoved: Move complete. Build a wall beside your character.
WallGo.logWall: Built a wall on the {direction} side of {cell}.
WallGo.logTimeoutWall: Time expired. A legal wall was built automatically.
WallGo.logTimeoutTurn: Time expired. A legal turn was played automatically.
WallGo.logWinner: {player} has the largest territory. Game over!
WallGo.tutorial1Desc: Move characters and build walls until each player's space is completely separated.
WallGo.tutorial2Desc: Move one character one or two tiles in a straight line, then build a wall on one of its sides.
WallGo.tutorial3Desc: Each player can break one wall in their movement path per game. Select a character and move to a red-marked tile.
WallGo.tutorial4Title: Territory is scored when everyone is separated
WallGo.tutorial4Desc: The game ends as soon as no space contains different players. Most claimed tiles wins; ties are decided by the largest single area.

Sudoku.description: Play free online Sudoku in easy, medium, and hard difficulties.
Sudoku.gameOverDesc: The game ended after three mistakes.
Sudoku.tip1Desc: Scan filled rows and columns to narrow down empty cells in each 3×3 box.
Sudoku.tip2Desc: Check rows, columns, and boxes with only one or two empty cells first.
Sudoku.tip3Desc: Press Space to turn on notes and record possible numbers.
Sudoku.tip4Desc: Every puzzle can be solved logically without guessing.

Tutorial.step0Desc: Let's take a quick look at the essential controls.
Tutorial.step1Desc: Tap a tile or use the arrow keys to move around the board.
Tutorial.step2Desc: Use the number pad or press 1–9 on your keyboard.
Tutorial.step3Desc: Press Space to turn on notes and record possible numbers.
Tutorial.step4Desc: You can make up to three mistakes. Go set a new best time!

privacySections.title: 1. Information we store
privacySections.body: PUZZLTHINK does not require an account. Game records and tutorial preferences are stored only in your browser.

privacySections.title: 2. How information is used
privacySections.body: Browser data is used to resume games, display match records, and improve your experience. It is not sent to our servers.

privacySections.title: 3. Local storage
privacySections.body: You can delete PUZZLTHINK local data from your browser settings at any time. Doing so resets records and preferences.

privacySections.title: 4. Service providers
privacySections.body: Our hosting provider may process technical logs needed for security and performance.

termsSections.title: 1. Using the service
termsSections.body: PUZZLTHINK is provided free for personal entertainment. Features and availability may change without notice.

termsSections.title: 2. Fair play
termsSections.body: You may not use automation to manipulate game records or results.

termsSections.title: 3. Intellectual property
termsSections.body: The service design, code, graphics, and game implementations are protected by the rights of their respective owners.

termsSections.title: 4. Disclaimer
termsSections.body: The service is provided as is. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability or protection from local data loss.

termsSections.title: 5. Contact
